profile.newIdRule: maximum existing profile id plus one

activeProfileField.name: activeProfileId
activeProfileField.meaning: zero-based index into profiles, despite the field name

profile.create: Codex Micro default profile containing the protected KV_OAI layer
profile.duplicate: append the selected profile with a new profile id and the same ordered layers
profile.deleteSelectionRule: when the selected profile is deleted, select the previous index when possible; otherwise keep the current valid index

layer.newIdRule: maximum existing layer id plus one
protectedLayerRules: not reordered away from index zero

create.name: Layer
create.lightingRule: copy the last layer lighting when present

layer.duplicate: append a deep copy with a new layer id and no linkedAppId
layer.deleteSelectionRule: select min(max(deleted index minus one, zero), remaining length minus one)

lighting.applyToAllRule: replace the selected zone on existing lighting and initialize both zones on layers without lighting

joystick.insertRule: insert before the requested zero-based index, then rebalance every sector
joystick.deleteRule: remove the requested zero-based index only while more than two sectors exist, then rebalance every sector

rebalance.remainingSectors: divide remainingArcTurns equally among sector count minus one, starting at firstEndTurns and modulo one

joystick.modeRule: switching to RADIAL with fewer than two sectors installs radialInitialization; switching to JOYSTICK preserves sectors
